```javascript
const textSchema = {
  type: 'object',
  properties: {
    text: {type: 'string'},
    mode: {type: 'string', enum: ['uppercase', 'lowercase', 'slug']},
    trim: {type: 'boolean'}
  },
  required: ['text', 'mode'],
  additionalProperties: false
};

const tools = [
  {
    name: 'text_transform',
    description: 'Transform text: uppercase, lowercase, or slug.',
    inputSchema: textSchema
  }
];

function validateArguments(schema, args) {
  // Check for unknown properties
  const allowed = new Set(Object.keys(schema.properties));
  for (const key of Object.keys(args)) {
    if (!allowed.has(key)) {
      throw new Error(`Unknown argument: ${key}`);
    }
  }
  // Check required
  for (const key of schema.required) {
    if (!(key in args)) {
      throw new Error(`Missing required argument: ${key}`);
    }
  }
  // Check types
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(args)) {
    const propSchema = schema.properties[key];
    if (propSchema.type === 'string') {
      if (typeof value !== 'string') {
        throw new Error(`Argument ${key} must be a string`);
      }
    } else if (propSchema.type === 'boolean') {
      if (typeof value !== 'boolean') {
        throw new Error(`Argument ${key} must be a boolean`);
      }
    }
    if (propSchema.enum && !propSchema.enum.includes(value)) {
      throw new Error(`Argument ${key} must be one of ${propSchema.enum.join(', ')}`);
    }
  }
}

function transform(text, mode, trim = true) {
  if (trim) text = text.trim();
  if (mode === 'uppercase') return text.toUpperCase();
  if (mode === 'lowercase') return text.toLowerCase();
  if (mode === 'slug') {
    return text.toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
      .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');
  }
}

export async function listTools() {
  return tools;
}

export async function callTool(name, args) {
  const tool = tools.find(t => t.name === name);
  if (!tool) {
    throw new Error(`Unknown tool: ${name}`);
  }
  validateArguments(tool.inputSchema, args);
  
  const {text, mode, trim = true} = args;
  const result = transform(text, mode, trim);
  
  return {
    content: [{type: 'text', text: result}]
  };
}
```
